_comment: The user's rulings on where topics start, by lecture key. Hand judgements, the grouping counterpart of runs/divisions.json. Positions are subtopic ids in the named voted division, so a ruling only applies to grouping runs made on that division. 'topicStarts' is every subtopic the user ruled opens a new topic; 'sameTopic' every subtopic ruled to stay in the topic before it; 'either' one set aside and scored neither way. A lecture with no entry here is unruled. Rulings were made on artifact pages that showed the full transcript, each contested point, and the topic names and reasons grouping runs gave on each side.

l1.note: Ruled from the 20 g6 and g11 runs. 2, 9 and 14 were starts every run made, shown as agreed and not ruled one by one. 17 is the closing goodbye, ruled its own topic in conversation. The five contested points, 5, 7, 12, 13 and 15, were all ruled 'same topic', giving five topics: opening, 2-8, 9-13, 14-16, closing.

notes.5: TLRs are associated with Innate immune recognition.
notes.12: this is not a clear topic on its own - it mixes part of the last topic with an aside.
notes.13: This should be in the same topic. perhaps there is a topic title before subtopic 9 that neatly incorporates all subtopics before the next agreed upon boundary??

l4.note: Only subtopic 22, the closing passage on risks versus benefits, has been ruled: its own topic. Lecture 4's pathogens and promotion topics are covered by the five criteria in runs/criteria.json. The soft points at 4 and 16 are unruled.
